2027-12-01.title: Trust the Lord
2027-12-01.verse: Because he could not be persuaded, we said no more except, “The Lord’s will be done.
2027-12-01.observation: Have you ever had a friend getting ready to do something you didn’t think was wise? Did you try to convince them to do something else? Many times, this can lead to a failed friendship or wondering why the Lord wasn’t stopping them. Instead, what if we did as Paul’s friends did? When they realized they could not stop Paul from making a different decision, they began to realize that God may be up to something. What seemed like a bad idea to them may be a vehicle the Lord would use for His ultimate good. Now, this does not mean that we smile if someone is heading into sin. We cannot say that a decision for them to cheat on their spouse is God’s good plan for them. However, we realize that God can turn even the worst decisions into something that brings Him glory. Who knows, maybe God was in it all along.
2027-12-01.application: Always be willing to speak truth in love to your friends, but ultimately trust the Lord.
2027-12-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us more than we realize.

2027-12-02.title: Your Secret Weapon
2027-12-02.verse: As I was en route and near Damascus, about noon a very bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around me. Then I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’ I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus the Nazarene, whom you are persecuting.’ Those who were with me saw the light, but did not understand the voice of the one who was speaking to me. So I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Get up and go to Damascus; there you will be told about everything that you have been designated to do.’ Since I could not see because of the brilliance of that light, I came to Damascus led by the hand of those who were with me.
2027-12-02.observation: From what we know from studying God’s Word and history, Paul was probably brilliant. He would have studied under the best teachers and knew multiple languages. However, when the pressure was on and he was giving what some may have considered the “speech of his life,” he did not default to his theological training. He defaulted to the most powerful thing he had, his testimony. He knew that all his good ideas could not change the hearts of people. Only the presence and power of God could do that. Paul shared with them how God had changed his life. The most powerful thing we have is not how great we are, but how powerful God has been in our lives. If you have someone in your life who is not a Christian, be prepared to answer questions, but be more prepared to share your story.
2027-12-02.application: Ask the Holy Spirit to open the door to share your story with someone today.
2027-12-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for changing our lives.

2027-12-03.title: The Lord Is There
2027-12-03.verse: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, “Have courage, for just as you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome.
2027-12-03.observation: I can only imagine how intimidating this season might have been for Paul. I have been in seasons when I was trying to honor God, but it did not seem as though there were any clear answers. Is it more honoring to go left or right? Should I honor God with this decision or that decision? If so many people disagree, is that God’s way of telling me I am going the wrong direction? In moments like this, it can be crushing to keep a proper perspective. The Lord came to Paul and reminded him of the ultimate mission. He was to continue sharing the good news in all the different environments this journey led him into. We need to also remember that our ultimate goal is to live for God and share His message. No matter where our good or bad decisions lead, always see them as an opportunity to live for the Lord in front of people. Not as a pride flex, but as a humble example of what God can do.
2027-12-03.application: See every situation as an opportunity to shine for God today.
2027-12-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us in every situation.

2027-12-04.title: Proclaim Your Allegiance
2027-12-04.verse: But I confess this to you, that I worship the God of our ancestors according to the Way (which they call a sect), believing everything that is according to the law and that is written in the prophets.
2027-12-04.observation: Paul is standing before a leader who can have him put to death. The charge is that he follows Jesus. Paul admits that he follows Jesus and that Jesus fulfills the hope his enemies cling to in their hearts. The Jewish people wanted the Messiah to come. They just wanted Him to come on their terms, in their way, with their ideas. When Jesus came in a different way, they rejected Him. Paul stands and says he is guilty as charged. He follows Jesus. In our lives, there will constantly be moments when we will be asked who we serve. It will likely not be in front of a leader like Felix. It will likely be in how we respond to challenges, how we live our lives, and how we show Christ to others. Who will you declare you follow today?
2027-12-04.application: Make it a point to live your faith out loud today.
2027-12-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being worth following.

2027-12-05.title: Give Them Nothing To Talk About
2027-12-05.verse: But I have nothing definite to write to my lord about him. Therefore I have brought him before you all, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that after this preliminary hearing I may have something to write. For it seems unreasonable to me to send a prisoner without clearly indicating the charges against him.
2027-12-05.observation: Paul may have said some things they disagreed with, but he had lived a life of goodness so that there was nothing harmful they could point to as something worthy of death. Festus needed something to write to the Emperor so they continued to examine Paul. In our lives, there will be people who do not agree with our pursuit of Christ. They will watch our lives, looking for something real. They will ask, “Do they truly believe what they say? Where are the skeletons in their closet?” Our job is not to be perfect. Our job is to always fall forward toward Christ. We do our best to honor God by how we live in front of others. Not as a way to show them how great we are. We show how great the goodness of Jesus is and how He came to free us from every bondage. Our lives are the greatest testimony to the power of Jesus.
2027-12-05.application: Give the gossips nothing to talk about except our consistent love for God.
2027-12-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for shining through our lives.

2027-12-06.title: Do You Wish Others Had What You Have?
2027-12-06.verse: Agrippa said to Paul, “In such a short time are you persuading me to become a Christian?” Paul replied, “I pray to God that whether in a short or a long time not only you but also all those who are listening to me today could become such as I am, except for these chains.
2027-12-06.observation: I was talking with someone the other day and they expressed that two things were happening in their life. They knew they were not walking closely with the Lord and they were experiencing heightened levels of anxiety. They knew these things were connected, yet were not doing anything about it. I could not judge this person because I have been there, too. We know what is wrong and we know the solution. Yet, in the depths of our difficulty, we seem to have no stamina to make a step forward. Paul wished for everyone to have what he had. Paul’s pursuit of God had not led to an easy life, but it was a blessed life full of seeing lives changed. We need to remember our walk with God is not an easy walk, but it is a powerful walk. It is full of highs and lows. Even in the low moments when we know what to do but do not do it, we are still blessed. We have hope that if we walk closer with the Lord, we can experience His presence. That can cause us to wish others had what we have. This is not because we have perfect lives. It is because we have hope.
2027-12-06.application: Share your hope with others without shame. This does not mean you have to have a perfect life. You’re sharing the fact you have hope.
2027-12-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being there.

2027-12-07.title: Don’t Be Afraid of Coming Storms
2027-12-07.verse: and said, ‘Do not be afraid, Paul! You must stand before Caesar, and God has graciously granted you the safety of all who are sailing with you.’ Therefore keep up your courage, men, for I have faith in God that it will be just as I have been told. But we must run aground on some island.
2027-12-07.observation: The Lord does three things for Paul in this passage. First, Paul is told that he has a future. God has planned for him to stand before Caesar. This means Paul will not die until this plan has been completed. Secondly, God warns Paul that it will not be an easy journey. There will be difficulties along the way. This will keep Paul from losing hope when bad days come. Finally, God tells Paul not to be afraid. In our lives, the Lord has given us similar promises. He has told us He will always be with us. He has told us there will be difficulties in life. He has told us He has a plan for our lives. Therefore, we should never allow fear to control our lives. No matter what comes, it will never take God by surprise. It may be difficult. It may be the worst thing imaginable, but God’s grace will always be there. So, do not be afraid.
2027-12-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us in every difficulty.

2027-12-08.title: The Gift of Encouragement
2027-12-08.verse: The brothers from there, when they heard about us, came as far as the Forum of Appius and Three Taverns to meet us. When he saw them, Paul thanked God and took courage.
2027-12-08.observation: Have you ever had someone in your life that was hard when it was time for gift giving? You loved this person, but you never knew what to give them. There is one gift that never gets old and is always welcomed by everyone. That gift is encouragement. When Paul arrived in Rome, it was at the end of a long journey. Also, Paul’s journey was not complete. He had not yet met with Caesar. However, when he saw the church in Rome, they gave Paul the greatest gift you can give a weary traveler. He received encouragement. Who do you need to give the gift of encouragement to today? Here are the ground rules. The first rule is to give it to someone you think needs it. The second rule is to write it down so they can look back at it when they need it the most. Rule three is to not expect anything in return. Rule four is to make the encouragement all about them. Do not insert yourself in any way. The final rule is to make sure it is sincere and specific. Watch what happens. I can guarantee it will bless your heart more than you can imagine. There is one word of warning. Many people are not good at receiving sincere encouragement. Therefore, do not judge your effectiveness based on their response. Be faithful and let God do what only He can do.
2027-12-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us in such a way that it gives us the capacity to love others.

2027-12-09.title: Obey God’s Word with Courage to Find Success
2027-12-09.verse: Make sure you are very strong and brave! Carefully obey all the law my servant Moses charged you to keep. Do not swerve from it to the right or to the left, so that you may be successful in all you do.
2027-12-09.observation: This is not some fortune-cookie saying. Joshua is about to embark on a massive campaign. His life is going to be in his hands continually. Not only his but everyone he leads. Few of us will encounter the type of stress Joshua must have faced at the moment. God gives him the keys to finding the hoped-for outcome… Have courage because you have been called to this. Study God’s Word so you know how to move forward. Move forward. This same template works for us today.
2027-12-09.application: Embrace each day with the same courage. Read God’s Word to know the “ground rules for life.” Move forward.
2027-12-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for choosing us to live today.

2027-12-10.title: The Lord Prepares The Way
2027-12-10.verse: They told Joshua, “Surely the Lord is handing over all the land to us! All who live in the land are cringing before us!
2027-12-10.observation: The Lord is always doing things that we know nothing about. On Christmas morning, the girls will wake up and come downstairs. They see the gifts and are excited. Not once do they think about the months of planning that went into getting them prepared. All they know is they are here now. God does this for us so much. While the nation of Israel was in the wilderness, while they were transferring leadership to Joshua, and while they were crossing the Jordan, God was already providing the next step. If we take care of our business, God will take care of His.
2027-12-10.application: Trust the Lord to make a bridge before we get to the water. If not, He’ll make a way through the sea.
2027-12-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us always trust in You, not just stare at the circumstances.

2027-12-11.title: The Lord Makes Us
2027-12-11.verse: The Lord told Joshua, “This very day I will begin to honor you before all Israel, so they will know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.
2027-12-11.observation: We have all heard of people doing the craziest things in order to stand out and get noticed. There was a trend a few years ago where people would eat something called “Tide Pods.” People were literally eating laundry soap to get attention, and some ended up in the hospital for their trouble. In today’s passage, the Lord had already brought Joshua through so much. Joshua was born a slave and was now in charge of a liberated nation. There is no way to be prepared for all that. However, the Lord said it was He who was going to distinguish Joshua and make Joshua all He needed to be. What would your life look like if you did the best you could with what you had been given and trusted the Lord to make you into all He had called you to be? This could change our whole outlook on life. When we go through trouble, we can see it as training ground. When we experience success, we realize it is due to the goodness of God. Everything has purpose and the Lord is in it all.
2027-12-11.application: Stop trying to stand out and start working toward becoming who the Lord has called you to be. He determines worldly success. All we control is effort.
2027-12-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being more involved in our lives than we could ever realize.

2027-12-12.title: Make A Plan to Remember
2027-12-12.verse: He told the Israelites, “When your children someday ask their fathers, ‘What do these stones represent?’
2027-12-12.observation: It’s so easy to forget God’s faithfulness because there is always something else over the horizon. The nation of Israel is about to have so much going on, it would be possible for them to forget even something as amazing as the Jordan River parting. The best chance to not forget is to plan for it. They set up a memorial so it would help them remember. This is a great idea.
2027-12-12.application: Set up ways to help you remember God’s faithfulness. Journal every time God does something.
2027-12-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us remember that You have always been faithful.

2027-12-13.title: Get Things in the Right Order
2027-12-13.verse: At that time the Lord told Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites once again.
2027-12-13.observation: I have heard people who say they like to have their dessert before they have their dinner. When I was a kid, the dessert was the reward for eating your vegetables. We can debate whether or not that was a good idea, but the lesson was helpful. If you want something good, do the work first. God is about to bless them. Before this, they have to enter into covenant with God first. This is God’s way of saying, “We’re in this together. Let Me see you all the way in, just like you expect Me to be all the way in.” We don’t tell God that if He will bless us we will be faithful. We go all in with Him and then the fruit of our relationship is His blessings.
2027-12-13.application: Go all the way with God.
2027-12-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us never back away from our commitment to You.

2027-12-14.title: Trust God’s Odd Ways
2027-12-14.verse: The seventh time around, the priests blew the rams’ horns, and Joshua told the army, “Give the battle cry, for the Lord is handing the city over to you!
2027-12-14.observation: It must have seemed odd to the nation of Israel to march around Jericho. It would have completely gone against any form of rational battle plan. However, God knew what He was doing and gave them the city with a miracle. When we follow God’s Word, it can sometimes seem counterintuitive. Does God really mean we have to forgive others, serve others, walk in freedom, and say no to our sinful desires? Yes. If we trust Him, we will see Him do miracles in our lives.
2027-12-14.application: Trust God’s Word over anything else.
2027-12-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us see the goodness of Your plans.

2027-12-16.title: Sin Hurts More Than You
2027-12-16.verse: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenantal commandment! They have taken some of the riches; they have stolen them and deceitfully put them among their own possessions.
2027-12-16.observation: Hurting people hurt people. When we are in sin or brokenness, it doesn’t just affect us. It comes out in ways we don’t even realize and affects others. We don’t live on an island. What we do affects others in ways we don’t realize. Therefore, we walk with repentant hearts not just for our sake, but the wholeness of others we encounter.
2027-12-16.application: Keep your heart right before God.
2027-12-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for reminding us that our lives are not just our own. They affect others too.

2027-12-17.title: Share the Truth
2027-12-17.verse: Then Joshua read aloud all the words of the law, including the blessings and the curses, just as they are written in the law scroll. Joshua read aloud every commandment Moses had given before the whole assembly of Israel, including the women, children, and resident foreigners who lived among them.
2027-12-17.observation: Joshua took time not to say, “Just trust me,” but shared the truth of God’s Word with others. As Christians, we must be careful to center our lives on God’s Word and then share God’s Word with others so they can, too. When we share God’s Word with others, people can experience the same life-changing experiences that we have found. Never be afraid to share God’s Word with everyone at all ages. God’s Word is what changes hearts.
2027-12-17.application: Create a meeting where you can share God’s Word back and forth with someone else. Watch how the power of God’s Word will grow you both.
2027-12-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for sharing Your Word with us.

2027-12-18.title: Take Time to Consult the Lord
2027-12-18.verse: The men examined some of their provisions, but they failed to ask the Lord’s advice.
2027-12-18.observation: This is a bad spot. Israel is doing what God has told them to do and people are trying to deceive them. Even though they are lying, the Gibeonites have set a convincing trap. There is a short sentence in this whole story that shows where Israel went wrong. They did the best they could, but they couldn’t see around corners. They should have consulted the Lord. This is not always easy because the pace of life often makes us think we have to have quick answers. We can also be afraid of looking foolish in front of our peers or think we have to have all the right answers all the time. However, look at the consequences of getting it wrong. This disaster would be with them permanently. It even plagued the first king of Israel.
2027-12-18.application: What does this look like practically? Pray before you begin the day. Ask the Lord to give you wisdom as you go. Before making big decisions, pray and ask God for wisdom. An extra moment for prayer can save a lifetime of grief.
2027-12-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for reminding us that we can always turn to You.

2027-12-19.title: God’s Promises Require We Get Our Hands Dirty
2027-12-19.verse: Then Joshua and all Israel returned to the camp at Gilgal.
2027-12-19.observation: For some reason, we tend to think God’s promises are like “Get out of jail free” cards. We place them down and God does the rest. It’s more accurate to think of God’s promises as God’s provision on the journey. We still have to do our part. Joshua and the armies have a lot of work to do. God is with them the whole way and causes their plans to succeed.
2027-12-19.application: Trust the Lord and get to work.
2027-12-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for partnering with us as we serve You.

2027-12-20.title: God’s Way Brings Rest
2027-12-20.verse: Joshua conquered the whole land, just as the Lord had promised Moses, and he assigned Israel their tribal portions. Then the land was free of war.
2027-12-20.observation: Over the past several chapters, the people have done great things and sometimes strange things. Let’s be honest, marching around a city for 7 days is strange. However, if God tells us to, He brings peace and rest with His commands. Trust Him and move forward.
2027-12-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always working for our good, even if that “good” is not what we had in mind.

2027-12-21.title: Keep a List of Victories
2027-12-21.verse: the king of Tirzah (one),a total of thirty-one kings.
2027-12-21.observation: Joshua kept a record of all the victories the Lord led them to. This is so important to us today. We need to have a list of victories so we can pull back and remember God’s goodness. I heard of a guy who keeps a mental record of all the bad things people have said about him so when he feels unmotivated, he can remember and work harder. That sounds like a miserable life. Instead, remember God’s faithfulness and realize that if He did it before, He can do it again.
2027-12-21.application: Journal something you are thankful for every day.
2027-12-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us keep Your goodness close to mind.

2027-12-22.title: Finish Strong
2027-12-22.verse: When Joshua was very old, the Lord told him, “You are very old, and a great deal of land remains to be conquered.
2027-12-22.observation: Joshua has been on a long journey. He began his life as a slave. He is coming to the end of his life as a conquering general. God visits him and acknowledges his age, yet says there is still purpose for him. One of the saddest things about great seasons is the let-down at the end. We can build ourselves up to make it to the top of the mountain only to realize life continues after the “big win.” The great thing about God is that He always has a good next step for us. Finish strong.
2027-12-22.application: Don’t quit. Keep going. Finish strong. Stay faithful.
2027-12-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us finish what we started.

2027-12-23.title: The Lord Does Not Forget His Promises
2027-12-23.verse: That day Moses made this solemn promise: ‘Surely the land on which you walked will belong to you and your descendants permanently, for you remained loyal to the Lord your God.’
2027-12-23.observation: Caleb had to watch an entire nation turn on God, say his report of the Promised Land was bogus, be judged by God, and slowly die off in the wilderness. I wonder if any of these caused him to doubt God’s promise. Looks like it didn’t. Now, after years of wandering in something he didn’t deserve, it is his turn to take the land he saw a long time ago. God remembered him and kept that promise. God is faithful.
2027-12-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us never let the circumstances around us cause us to doubt the promises You have made.

2027-12-24.title: Willing to Invest in the Next Generation
2027-12-24.verse: She answered, “Please give me a special present. Since you have given me land in the Negev, now give me springs of water.” So he gave her both the upper and lower springs.
2027-12-24.observation: I have heard of people who became wealthy but left their children nothing in their will. The mindset was they didn’t want to spoil their kids. They wanted their kids to learn the value of earning wealth. I understand the mindset of this, but we must be sure not to see all areas of life in this way. The generation behind us should be better because of us, not in spite of us. Caleb’s daughter went to her father to ask for an inheritance. He was willing to give it. Be sure to have something to give those behind you. I’m not thinking of a wealth of things. I’m thinking of a wealth of wisdom, time, attention, and mentoring.
2027-12-24.application: Make time for those coming up next.
2027-12-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us see all that we have as a temporary stewardship.

2027-12-25.title: Play Now, Pay Later
2027-12-25.verse: The Ephraimites did not conquer the Canaanites living in Gezer. The Canaanites live among the Ephraimites to this very day and do hard labor as their servants.
2027-12-25.observation: One of the reasons the Book of Judges is such a mess is because Israel did not drive them out. They turned some of these nations into slaves. This was not God’s plan. The plan was for them to be out of there. This creates negative influences. Possibly, Israel thought they were doing something even better than God’s plan because they got free labor. Saul thought the same thing. The result… devastation. God knows what He is doing. Even if doing things God’s way seems like “more work” or “not wise” at the time. Trust the Lord.
2027-12-25.application: Obey God’s Word. It always pays off.
2027-12-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us know Your Word so we can do what You say.

2027-12-26.title: Living in the Tension
2027-12-26.verse: Joshua said to the family of Joseph—to both Ephraim and Manasseh: “You have many people and great military strength. You will not have just one tribal allotment.
2027-12-26.observation: They came to Joshua and said they were thankful for what they had, but it wasn’t enough. They were thankful but wanted more. This is like life for most of us. We are thankful for what we have but always needing more. Joshua was willing to give them more but it also meant they were going to have to take it over as well. This means that God is often willing to give us more but when more is given, responsibility increases. Be sure you count the cost before asking for more.
2027-12-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the wisdom to always count the cost before moving forward.

2027-12-27.title: God’s Promises Require Action
2027-12-27.verse: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath—a total of 14 cities and their towns. This was the land assigned to the tribe of Benjamin by its clans.
2027-12-27.observation: This chapter is full of God’s open doors. The goal is to take each one of them and move forward.
2027-12-27.application: When God opens a door, move forward.
2027-12-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us take action when it is time.

2027-12-28.title: Honor Your Leaders
2027-12-28.verse: When they finished dividing the land into its regions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun some land.
2027-12-28.observation: Joshua had served the people of Israel for a long time. Many people have a wrong idea of leadership. They see someone “at the top” making decisions and think they have it made. (Many people at the top act this way.) The reality is leadership is serving. The leader serves those they lead by making those decisions and doing the ‘hard things.’ Everyone wants to be a leader until it gets hard. Then they are happy to pass the problems away. Because of this, we should not seek to be a leader nor should we pile on more than necessary. We should honor our leaders. We know God is Sovereign and will use those leaders to accomplish His will.
2027-12-28.application: Honor a leader in your life today.
2027-12-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us be grateful for those in leadership in our lives.

2027-12-29.title: A Place to Run
2027-12-29.verse: Have the Israelites select the cities of refuge that I told you about through Moses.
2027-12-29.observation: Cities of refuge were places people could go if they had been accused of killing someone. If they could make it to this city, they would be protected until the truth could come out. There are two things that struck me about this. First, it’s amazing how the Lord set this up. This keeps the innocent from being murdered as well as making sure the guilty would not be able to escape punishment. If they were guilty, the city of refuge would not keep them. The other is how we need this and need to give this to others. Everyone needs a place where everyone knows your name and is always glad you came.
2027-12-29.application: Be a “City of Refuge” for someone today.
2027-12-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being our everlasting City of Refuge.

2027-12-31.title: The Lord is Faithful Over the Years
2027-12-31.verse: Not one of the Lord’s faithful promises to the family of Israel was left unfulfilled; every one was realized.
2027-12-31.observation: There is a statement that says, “You can’t see the forest for the trees.” This means you get so obsessed about something specific, you cannot see the overall picture. Many times, when God does something in our lives, we can be so quick to go on to the next thing, we forget to look back and see how far He has brought us. The book of Joshua looks back over all that has happened and remarks that God really did do all He said He would do. Not a SINGLE THING was left undone.
2027-12-31.application: Take time to look back and be thankful.
2027-12-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your consistent faithfulness over the years.
